processes:task-ao-design-intake-v2uckf.plain_language_name: Receive the Role Catalogue and Supervision Matrix
processes:task-ao-design-intake-v2uckf.plain_language_description: Path definition opens when the regulator-tied role catalogue and the supervision matrix are handed to the intake custodian. Both are accepted, registered with audit identifiers, and set down as the material the paths will be defined from.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-v2uckf.business_purpose: It exists so notification paths are defined from a registered catalogue against a registered supervision matrix.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-v2uckf.practical_context: It opens when the role catalogue and supervision matrix are presented for the definition, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the role catalogue and supervision matrix as the definition baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-ftvjr.plain_language_name: Define the Notification Path for Each Licensed Role
processes:task-ao-design-transform-ftvjr.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian makes the definition itself: for each regulator-licensed role, who the continuing supervisor is, how often notifications go out, what they carry, and how escalation runs are worked out and set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-ftvjr.business_purpose: It exists because a licensed role without a defined path to its supervisor cannot be supervised in operation.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-ftvjr.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be defined from, and it ends with the defined notification paths produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the organization design authority defines each licensed role's supervisor, cadence, and escalation route, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-ao-design-verify-bwnb99.plain_language_name: Check the Definition Inputs Before Defining the Paths
processes:task-ao-design-verify-bwnb99.plain_language_description: Before any path is defined, the verification custodian checks the catalogue and supervision matrix against what definition requires - that every licensed role in the catalogue has a supervision line to define against. Gaps are flagged for rejection or repair before the paths are written.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-bwnb99.business_purpose: It exists so no licensed role is left without its notification path because its supervision line was missing.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-bwnb99.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their gaps logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a licensed role with no supervision line in the matrix and flags the gap before its path is defined.

processes:task-ao-design-record-sfgczh.plain_language_name: File the Fitness Regime Audit Record
processes:task-ao-design-record-sfgczh.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the definition trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What each role's fitness regime requires, and on what matrix reading it rests, remains readable for as long as the regime governs.
processes:task-ao-design-record-sfgczh.business_purpose: It exists so the fitness regime set for each role can be evidenced whenever its application is questioned.
processes:task-ao-design-record-sfgczh.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the regime trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a fitness review would consult.

processes:task-ao-design-confirm-45k77k.plain_language_name: Confirm the Defined Fitness Assessment Regimes
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-45k77k.plain_language_description: When the regimes stand defined, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The mobilization design downstream learns each licensed role's fitness regime is settled and available.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-45k77k.business_purpose: It exists so downstream design builds only over fitness regimes confirmed against the intended result.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-45k77k.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the defined regimes await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the defined regimes against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the downstream work needs.

processes:task-ao-design-intake-gbaudu.plain_language_name: Receive the Role Catalogue and Fitness Matrix
processes:task-ao-design-intake-gbaudu.plain_language_description: Regime definition opens when the regulator-tied role catalogue and the fitness-and-propriety matrix are handed to the intake custodian. Both are accepted, registered with audit identifiers, and set down as the material the regime will be defined from.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-gbaudu.business_purpose: It exists so fitness assessment regimes are defined from a registered catalogue against a registered matrix.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-gbaudu.practical_context: It opens when the role catalogue and fitness matrix are presented for the definition, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the role catalogue and fitness matrix as the definition baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-e8kqf.plain_language_name: Define the Fitness Assessment Regime for Each Role
processes:task-ao-design-transform-e8kqf.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian makes the definition itself: for each licensed role, the assessment forms - initial, annual, and event-driven - the criteria, the attestor, and the framing the regulator applies are set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-e8kqf.business_purpose: It exists because fitness attestations can only be made, and trusted, against a regime defined in advance for the role.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-e8kqf.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be defined from, and it ends with the defined fitness assessment regime produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the organization design authority defines each licensed role's assessment forms, criteria, and attestor, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-ao-design-verify-mg9myj.plain_language_name: Check the Regime Inputs Before Defining
processes:task-ao-design-verify-mg9myj.plain_language_description: Before any regime is written, the verification custodian checks the catalogue and matrix against what definition requires - that each licensed role in the catalogue has its fitness criteria and attestor settled in the matrix. Gaps are flagged for rejection or repair before the regimes are defined.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-mg9myj.business_purpose: It exists so no licensed role carries a fitness regime that was never fully settled for it.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-mg9myj.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their gaps logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a licensed role whose attestor is unset in the matrix and flags the gap before its regime is defined.

processes:task-ao-design-record-d4f56k.plain_language_name: File the Role Accountability Audit Record
processes:task-ao-design-record-d4f56k.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the bounding trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What each role was made answerable for, and where its accountability ends, stays readable whenever responsibility in the live organisation is disputed.
processes:task-ao-design-record-d4f56k.business_purpose: It exists so the accountabilities fixed on each role can be evidenced whenever they are tested.
processes:task-ao-design-record-d4f56k.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the accountability trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles an accountability review would consult.

processes:task-ao-design-confirm-qzh2hv.plain_language_description: When the boundaries stand drawn, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The consolidation step that follows learns the accountabilities are bounded and the catalogue can be assembled.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-qzh2hv.business_purpose: It exists so the catalogue is committed only with accountabilities confirmed as bounded.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-qzh2hv.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the bounded accountabilities await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the bounded accountabilities against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the consolidation step needs.

processes:task-ao-design-intake-exzf93.plain_language_name: Receive the Role Levels for Accountability Bounding
processes:task-ao-design-intake-exzf93.plain_language_description: Accountability bounding opens when the defined role levels are handed over as the roles whose boundaries of accountability must be drawn. The intake custodian accepts them, registers the handover with audit identifiers, and starts the bounding work from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-exzf93.business_purpose: It exists so accountabilities are bounded within a registered set of role levels rather than informally.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-exzf93.practical_context: It opens when the role levels are presented for the bounding, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the defined role levels as the bounding baseline, with audit references, and opens the accountability work.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-vj5f4.plain_language_name: Bound the Accountabilities of Each Catalogued Role
processes:task-ao-design-transform-vj5f4.plain_language_description: With the levels verified, the processing custodian bounds the accountabilities themselves: what each catalogued role is answerable for, and where its accountability ends, is worked out and fixed in the form the activity defines. Working papers behind each boundary are preserved.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-vj5f4.business_purpose: It exists because a role with unbounded accountabilities becomes either a bottleneck or a scapegoat.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-vj5f4.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified levels are ready to be bounded, and it ends with the bounded role accountabilities produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the organization design authority fixes what each catalogued role answers for and where its accountability ends, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-ao-design-verify-enyuz3.plain_language_name: Check the Levels Before Bounding the Accountabilities
processes:task-ao-design-verify-enyuz3.plain_language_description: Before any boundary is drawn, the verification custodian checks the role levels against what bounding requires - that each levelled role is settled enough for its accountabilities to be fixed. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before any boundary is drawn.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-enyuz3.business_purpose: It exists so accountability is never fixed to a role whose level was never fully settled.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-enyuz3.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the levels can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a levelled role still missing its reporting place and logs the defect before accountabilities are bounded.

processes:task-ao-design-record-ugpdhe.plain_language_name: File the Role Catalogue Audit Record
processes:task-ao-design-record-ugpdhe.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the consolidation trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What was committed as the catalogue, and on whose confirmation, stays on file for the life of the catalogue.
processes:task-ao-design-record-ugpdhe.business_purpose: It exists so the catalogue's standing as the canonical reference can be evidenced whenever provisioning leans on it.
processes:task-ao-design-record-ugpdhe.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record stored at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the consolidation trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a provisioning review would draw on.

processes:task-ao-design-confirm-yc6q5f.plain_language_description: When the catalogue stands committed, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The provisioning work downstream learns the canonical reference is ready to be received.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-yc6q5f.business_purpose: It exists so provisioning starts only from a catalogue confirmed against the intended result.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-yc6q5f.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the committed catalogue awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the committed catalogue against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation provisioning is waiting on.

processes:task-ao-design-intake-c4mfm2.plain_language_name: Receive the Bounded Accountabilities for Catalogue Commitment
processes:task-ao-design-intake-c4mfm2.plain_language_description: Commitment opens when the bounded role accountabilities are handed over as the last piece of the catalogue. The intake custodian accepts the handover, registers it with audit identifiers, and puts the consolidation on a recorded footing.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-c4mfm2.business_purpose: It exists so the catalogue is committed from a registered set of bounded roles rather than from loose pieces.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-c4mfm2.practical_context: It opens when the bounded accountabilities are presented for commitment, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps free to run.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the bounded accountabilities as the commitment baseline, with audit references, and opens the consolidation.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-5x7fd.plain_language_name: Consolidate the Catalogue as the Canonical Reference
processes:task-ao-design-transform-5x7fd.plain_language_description: With the accountabilities verified, the processing custodian consolidates the catalogue itself: families, levels, and bounded accountabilities are brought together, ratified, and set down in the form the activity defines as the canonical reference downstream provisioning will work from. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-5x7fd.business_purpose: It exists because roles only staff the organisation once the catalogue stands as one committed reference instead of many drafts.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-5x7fd.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified accountabilities are ready to be consolidated, and it ends with the committed role catalogue produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the organization design authority consolidates the catalogue into the canonical reference provisioning will work from, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-ao-design-verify-ynnbs7.plain_language_name: Check the Accountabilities Before Committing the Catalogue
processes:task-ao-design-verify-ynnbs7.plain_language_description: Before the catalogue is committed, the verification custodian checks the bounded accountabilities against what commitment requires - that families, levels, and boundaries together make a complete, coherent catalogue. Anything found wanting is logged for rejection or repair before the commitment is made.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-ynnbs7.business_purpose: It exists so provisioning never runs against a catalogue committed in an incomplete state.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-ynnbs7.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the accountabilities can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a family whose roles lack bounded accountabilities and logs the defect before the catalogue is committed.

processes:task-ao-design-record-n42uvs.plain_language_name: File the Role Family Audit Record
processes:task-ao-design-record-n42uvs.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the definition trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. Which families were defined, and from what frame reading, stays provable whenever the catalogue's shape is examined.
processes:task-ao-design-record-n42uvs.business_purpose: It exists so the families behind the catalogue can be evidenced against the frame that produced them.
processes:task-ao-design-record-n42uvs.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record stored at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the family trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a catalogue review would consult.

processes:task-ao-design-confirm-q2ap3z.plain_language_description: When the families stand defined, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The levelling work that follows learns the families are settled and ready to be structured.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-q2ap3z.business_purpose: It exists so role levels are defined only within families confirmed against the intended result.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-q2ap3z.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the defined families await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-ao-design-intake-zeuvvz.plain_language_name: Receive the Model Frame for Family Definition
processes:task-ao-design-intake-zeuvvz.plain_language_description: The catalogue work opens when the committed organization model frame is handed over as the structure whose roles will be grouped into families. The intake custodian accepts it, registers it with audit identifiers, and starts the definition from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-zeuvvz.business_purpose: It exists so role families are defined from the committed model frame rather than from ad hoc groupings.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-zeuvvz.practical_context: It opens when the model frame is presented for the family definition, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the committed model frame as the family baseline, with audit references, and opens the catalogue work.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-stp7p.plain_language_name: Group the Catalogue's Roles into Families
processes:task-ao-design-transform-stp7p.plain_language_description: With the frame verified, the processing custodian makes the definition itself: the role families that group the catalogue's roles are worked out from the frame and set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-stp7p.business_purpose: It exists because a catalogue of loose roles is unmanageable until the families that order it are defined.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-stp7p.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified frame is ready to be grouped from, and it ends with the defined role families produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the organization design authority groups the catalogue's roles into families drawn from the frame, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-ao-design-verify-2gbk54.plain_language_name: Check the Model Frame Before Defining the Families
processes:task-ao-design-verify-2gbk54.plain_language_description: Before any family is defined, the verification custodian checks the model frame against what definition requires - that its roles are enumerated fully enough to be grouped. Gaps are logged for rejection or repair before any family is named.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-2gbk54.business_purpose: It exists so no catalogue role is left outside every family because the frame was read incompletely.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-2gbk54.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the frame can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its gaps logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a set of roles the frame does not yet enumerate and logs the gap before families are defined.

processes:task-ao-design-record-thasb5.plain_language_name: File the Role Level Audit Record
processes:task-ao-design-record-thasb5.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the definition trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. processes:task-ao-design-record-thasb5.business_purpose: It exists so the leveling structure within each family can be evidenced whenever it is applied or questioned.
processes:task-ao-design-record-thasb5.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record held at its tier and retrieval handles in place.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the level trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a role review would consult.

processes:task-ao-design-confirm-3qbw2v.plain_language_description: When the levels stand defined, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-ao-design-confirm-3qbw2v.business_purpose: It exists so accountabilities are bounded only within levels confirmed against the intended result.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-3qbw2v.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the defined levels await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-ao-design-intake-kwr7x2.business_purpose: It exists so role levels are defined within a registered set of families rather than free-floating.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-kwr7x2.practical_context: It opens when the role families are presented for the level definition, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps free to run.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-u5vv8.plain_language_description: With the families verified, the processing custodian makes the definition itself: the leveling structure applied within each role family is worked out and set down in the form the activity defines. processes:task-ao-design-transform-u5vv8.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified families are ready to be levelled, and it ends with the defined role levels produced and the working papers kept.

processes:task-ao-design-verify-fqbesq.plain_language_name: Check the Families Before Defining the Levels
processes:task-ao-design-verify-fqbesq.plain_language_description: Before any structure is defined, the verification custodian checks the role families against what definition requires - that each family is settled enough to carry a leveling structure within it. processes:task-ao-design-verify-fqbesq.business_purpose: It exists so no family is levelled before it has been settled as a family.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-fqbesq.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the families can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their gaps logged for rejection or remediation.

processes:task-ao-improve-record-qgqttw.plain_language_name: File the Competency Baseline Audit Record
processes:task-ao-improve-record-qgqttw.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the baselining trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the baselining trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a later gap review would consult.

processes:task-ao-improve-confirm-89fgmj.plain_language_description: When the baseline stands measured, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-ao-improve-confirm-89fgmj.business_purpose: It exists so gaps are identified only against a baseline confirmed as measured.
processes:task-ao-improve-confirm-89fgmj.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the baseline awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-ao-improve-intake-hmehhn.practical_context: It opens when the framework and population are presented for baselining, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

processes:task-ao-improve-transform-hbkb.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be measured from, and it ends with the population competency baseline produced and the working papers kept.

processes:task-ao-improve-record-ctdhgp.business_purpose: It exists so the priorities routed to development can be evidenced whenever the effort's direction is reviewed.
processes:task-ao-improve-record-ctdhgp.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

processes:task-ao-improve-confirm-n625pw.plain_language_description: When the priorities stand committed, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation.
